text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2023.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2023

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion dua ratus

lapan puluh juta sembilan puluh satu ribu ringgit (RM1,280,091,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2023 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan

bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 333,326,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 281,380,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 84,236,000

Perbelanjaan lain 140,295,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 440,854,000

JUMLAH 1,280,091,000

Dibuat 30 Julai 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(31); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2023

IN excercise of the powers conferred by section 72

of the Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2023.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2023

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion two hundred and eighty million

ninety-one thousand ringgit (RM1,280,091,000) from the Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2023

is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 333,326,000

Supplies and services 281,380,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 84,236,000

Other expenditures 140,295,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 440,854,000

TOTAL 1,280,091,000

Made 30 July 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.2(31); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

 Minister of Human Resources
